note:
Closed the tools/_probe_bridgebuilder.mjs vs unity/Assets/Editor/Probes/BridgeProbe.cs mismatch on the 11 REAL_BRIDGES (buildRealBridges/realBridgeZones). Final run: 419/419 values match to float32 precision (tools/unity_port_check.py PASS, worst rel diff 8.2e-06). Three distinct root causes, found by ruling field-order misalignment OUT first (both probes print IDENTICAL BRIDGEGEO<n> key/field skeletons; the earlier 0.94-vs-4.08 'half'-looking mismatch was a truncated-output misread, not a shape bug):

1. REAL BridgeBuilder.cs BUG (fixed): `static readonly int[] Sgn = { -1, 1 };` is correct for src/bridges.js's fascia-wall/pier loops (bridges.js:183,290 `for (const s of [-1,1])`, matching src/roads.js:350/367/391's BuildSpans convention too) but WRONG for the deck-slab/rail/lamp loops (bridges.js:123,143,165 `for (const sgn/side of [1,-1])` — the opposite order). BridgeBuilder.cs used the single `Sgn` array for all of them, so the 'first' rail/lamp record per bridge came out as side=-1 instead of side=+1: position off by 2*half along the deck normal (sqrt(24^2+17^2)=29.41 == 2*14.7 for Dochanashvili) and angle off by exactly PI (0.9405 vs 4.0821, Baratashvili; 0.9385 vs 4.0801, Dry Bridge). Fix: added `static readonly int[] SgnOuterFirst = { 1, -1 };` and pointed the deck-slab (BridgeBuilder.cs ~L206), rail (~L242) and lamp (~L272) loops at it, each commented with its own bridges.js line. Vertex counts/bounds were never affected (every (sgn,t) pair still runs exactly once either way) — only which element a consumer reads as 'first'.

2. PROBE transcription bug in tools/_probe_bridgebuilder.mjs (fixed, src/bridges.js untouched): the fascia-wall/rail-cap vertex-count block only ran ONE side with an off-by-one approximation for the wall, instead of the real `for (const s of [-1,1])` wrapping both the wall AND its rail/stone-cap (bridges.js:183-220). Undercounted concVerts by 4 verts x 10 non-stone bridges (=40), railVerts by exactly half (1804 vs the real 3608), stoneVerts by 84 (Dry Bridge's one-side shortfall on both the wall and the cap). Rewrote the block to loop both sides faithfully while keeping the existing side=+1,t=0 diagnostic sample (fasciaTop0/fasciaBot0) unchanged.

3. PROBE bookkeeping gap, same file (fixed): the stone-parapet-cap branch (railH===0, Dry Bridge only) incremented `stoneVerts` as a bare counter and never fed its real y-range (bridges.js:210-212, `ay + 1.1` .. `ay + 2.1`) into the stoneMinY/stoneMaxY tracker, so the probe's stoneMaxY under-read the true bound (102.1 vs the correct 103.0) even though BridgeBuilder.cs's own `stone.Quad(..., pa.y + 2.1f, ...)` was already right. Fixed by calling `addStone(ay+1.1, ay+2.1)` (x2, one per face) instead of a bare `stoneVerts += 8`.

4. PROBE bug in unity/Assets/Editor/Probes/BridgeProbe.cs's RunRoundTie (fixed): it called raw `Mathf.RoundToInt(85f/34f)` to demonstrate Unity's native tie-breaking, but BridgeBuilder.cs's real nLamp line was ALREADY fixed (by the user, just before this task) to use `Data.JsMath.Round`. Testing the unguarded intrinsic instead of the actual guarded call path meant this probe would report a 'mismatch' forever (3 vs 2) even though the real bug was fixed, and would stop catching a future regression. Fixed to call `Data.JsMath.Round(85f/34f)`, which now reads 3, matching JS.

Also independently verified (not changed, already correct going in): the user's two same-day BridgeBuilder.cs edits — the full-width deck slab writing into `conc` regardless of kind (src/bridges.js:124's hardcoded `quad(conc, ...)`, moving Dry Bridge's 56 deck-slab verts out of the stone mesh) and nLamp's `Data.JsMath.Round` guard — both proved correct once the probe's own bugs above were fixed; concVerts/stoneVerts/BRIDGE_ROUND_TIE_L85 all now match exactly.

Not touched, out of scope: BuildSpans (src/roads.js:146-465, the OTHER ~320 lines docs/port_units/roads.json's whole-file claim on this cs file covers) — unaffected by any of the above, already exercised by RoadProbe/AirRoadsProbe/CityRoadsProbe.
